chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Isa al-Farra, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When one commences the Umrah with Ihram in Rajab and exits Ihram in another month, his Umrah is for Rajab; and when he commences in a month other than Rajab and performs Tawaf in Rajab, his Umrah is for Rajab.

key_terms.إِهْلَال: Commencing the ritual state of Ihram
key_terms.رَجَب: The seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar

ai.seo_question: How is the month of Umrah determined if Ihram and Tawaf occur in different months?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the juristic principle of attributing the virtue of Umrah to Rajab based on the timing of either the initial Ihram or the concluding Tawaf, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maximizing rewards through specific temporal markers. It highlights the scholarly consensus that the sanctity of the month is secured as long as one of these key ritual components occurs within Rajab, thereby encouraging believers to align their pilgrimage intentions with the blessed months. This ruling underscores the practical application of time-based merit in Shia fiqh, where the spiritual weight of an act is often linked to the holiness of the period in which it is initiated or completed.
